THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

THE SCENE

You are the reporter on the school news show. The show is happening right now. Today is Rocket Day, and the science club just sent a small rocket up. You must tell everyone how high it went. Two teams measured it from two places, and their answers must match. Four people each have one number you need.

THE HISTORY

Rocket Day is named for Katherine Johnson, a Black math expert. In 1962, her team at NASA sent John Glenn around Earth. Glenn asked her to check the computer's numbers by hand. Her numbers matched, and Glenn flew.
